title: 3-Acetyl-11-Keto-Beta-Boswellic Acid Inhibits Adipogenesis by Suppressing Autophagy and Inducing AMPK Phosphorylation in 3T3-L1 Cells.
authors: Khan, Faizullah; Waqas, Muhammad; Moghtaderi, Hassan; Rehman, Najeeb Ur; Avula, Satya Kumar; Khan, Haroon; Choudhury, Mahua; Al-Harrasi, Ahmed; Rahman, Shaikh Mizanoor
journal: Cellular physiology and biochemistry : international journal of experimental cellular physiology, biochemistry, and pharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究AKBA抑制脂肪细胞分化，仅用分子对接评估小分子与PPARgamma/ATG5的弱结合，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关系甚微。
abstract: BACKGROUND/AIMS: Adipogenesis involves preadipocyte differentiation and lipid droplet accumulation and is closely linked to obesity. 3-Acetyl-11-keto-beta-boswellic acid (AKBA), a frankincense-derived triterpene, has anti-inflammatory and anticancer properties, but its role in adipocyte differentiation remains unclear. METHODS: 3T3-L1 preadipocytes were induced to differentiate with or without varying concentrations of AKBA. Cell viability was assessed by MTT assay, lipid accumulation by Oil Red O staining, and apoptosis by annexin V-FITC assay. Expression of adipogenic transcription factors, lipid-associated proteins, apoptotic markers, autophagy-related proteins, and AMPK phosphorylation was analysed by Western blotting. Molecular docking was used to evaluate AKBA interactions with target proteins. RESULTS: AKBA inhibited adipocyte differentiation by suppressing C/EBPbeta, C/EBPalpha, and PPARgamma expression, reduced lipid accumulation, increased apoptosis via an elevated Bax/Bcl2 ratio, suppressed autophagy markers ATG5 and LC3b, and enhanced AMPK phosphorylation. Docking studies suggested AKBA binding to PPARgamma and ATG5. CONCLUSION: AKBA suppresses adipogenesis by inhibiting adipogenic transcription factors, autophagy, and activating AMPK, supporting its potential as an anti-obesity therapeutic candidate.
abstract_zh: 背景/目的：脂肪生成涉及前脂肪细胞分化和脂滴积累，并与肥胖密切相关。3-乙酰基-11-酮基-β-乳香酸（AKBA）是一种源自乳香的三萜类化合物，具有抗炎和抗癌特性，但其在脂肪细胞分化中的作用仍不清楚。方法：诱导3T3-L1前脂肪细胞在有或无不同浓度AKBA的条件下分化。通过MTT法评估细胞活力，油红O染色评估脂质积累，annexin V-FITC法评估细胞凋亡。通过Western blotting分析脂肪生成转录因子、脂质相关蛋白、凋亡标志物、自噬相关蛋白及AMPK磷酸化的表达。使用分子对接评估AKBA与靶蛋白的相互作用。结果：AKBA通过抑制C/EBPbeta、C/EBPalpha和PPARgamma表达来抑制脂肪细胞分化，减少脂质积累，通过升高Bax/Bcl2比值增加细胞凋亡，抑制自噬标志物ATG5和LC3b，并增强AMPK磷酸化。对接研究表明AKBA可与PPARgamma和ATG5结合。结论：AKBA通过抑制脂肪生成转录因子、自噬并激活AMPK来抑制脂肪生成，支持其作为抗肥胖治疗候选药物的潜力。
